consentHelp.message: Without consent, nothing is sent externally. After consent, only explicitly authorized messages or senders are scanned. Hashes, domains and public IPs may be sent in Strict; Balanced also permits unknown file uploads; Maximum also permits complete URL uploads. Turn this option off to stop new transfers and cancel pending requests. Previously transmitted data cannot be recalled.

privacyLocalData.message: Thundy AV reads the displayed message, its sender, subject, headers, text and attachments to perform local checks. Local checks work without API keys. There is no telemetry and no developer analysis server.

privacyProviders.message: Authorized external requests go directly to configured providers: Hybrid Analysis for file hashes and uploads, VirusTotal for file hashes or IP reputation, URLhaus for domains, urlscan.io for complete URLs and AbuseIPDB for public IPs. Hashes can identify known files. Provider terms and privacy policies apply; submitted data may be shared by the provider.

privacyRetention.message: Settings, consent, sender authorizations and API keys are stored in your Thunderbird profile. API keys are not encrypted there. Local scan records can include subjects, sender addresses, complete links and attachment metadata. The cache retains up to 1,000 message records for 30 days and is cleaned on database startup. In-memory reputation results expire after 15 minutes.

privacyControl.message: Turn off external analysis to stop new requests and cancel pending requests. Already transmitted data cannot be recalled. Use Clear cache to delete stored analysis results and reputation caches. Individual sender authorizations can be removed in settings.

senderAuthorizationsLabel.message: Authorized senders (one email address per line)

senderAuthorizationsHelp.message: These senders may be scanned automatically when external analysis is enabled. Remove an address to stop automatic scans for future messages. This list does not bypass the privacy tier or manual mode.

invalidSenderAddress.message: Enter plain email addresses, one per line.

popupLocalExplanation.message: Local indicators only. This score is not an antivirus verdict or a guarantee of safety.

linkOpenFailed.message: The link could not be opened. Try again or check your default browser settings.

linkCheckLimited.message: Only available scan results can be shown. Missing checks do not mean a link is safe.

auditScope.message: Logs HTTP(S) clicks intercepted by link protection. OPENED means Thunderbird accepted the opening request without reporting an error. This does not confirm that the operating system started a browser or that the website was visited. Native context-menu opens are not recorded.

auditPrivacy.message: Stored locally for up to 30 days, 2,000 records or 2 MiB (oldest entries are removed). Full URLs may contain personal data or access tokens. Nothing is uploaded automatically. The local log can be changed or deleted by profile users; it is not a tamper-proof central audit trail. The local score uses the clicked link and message context, not a provider score. Assessment reasons may include sender or domain details.

auditExportHelp.message: Exports include all filtered rows, not just the current page. JSON includes a SHA-256 checksum for verification; it does not prove authenticity. CSV neutralizes spreadsheet formulas. Exports contain complete URLs: share only with authorized reviewers.

auditClearConfirm.message: Delete all local link log entries? Export required evidence first. Scan results and settings are kept.

auditFailure.message: The local link log could not be read or saved.

profilesRequirementsHelp.message: Endpoint and account settings are supplied during later setup. The names below identify required settings and secret references; enter no credentials here.

wizardLanguageNote.message: The add-on follows the Thunderbird language. This selection changes only this wizard.

wizardIntro.message: Start with local checks. To inspect an email, use its Thundy AV banner or scan action. You can decide later whether to configure analysis providers.

wizardLocalNotice.message: Without consent to external analysis, no data is sent to analysis providers. This wizard never grants that consent.

wizardLinkChoice.message: Warn before opening links and record decisions locally

wizardLinkExplanation.message: The link dialog shows the destination and available risk assessment. Opening hands the link to your browser; it does not prove a website visit.

wizardAuditNotice.message: The local link log can include full URLs and assessment reasons. It keeps up to 30 days, 2,000 entries or 2 MiB. Profile users can read, change or delete it; it is not a protected corporate audit.

wizardExternalExplanation.message: External providers are optional and may require API keys. Depending on your privacy tier, hashes, domains, public IPs, files or full URLs can be transmitted. Configure providers and grant consent in settings.

wizardNextAction.message: What would you like to do next?
